text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Deployment health degraded for inference-service (canary). CrashLoopBackOff on 4/5 pods, HPA scaled from 2 -> 10 in 90s. Auto-escalation triggered. https://infra.redwood/alerts/3345678901 :rotating_light:

jake_oncall: on it, paging in SRE. @maria_sre can you grab logs + recent deployment manifest?

maria_sre: I have pods, seeing repeated OOM/killed or model init fail:
```
kubectl logs inference-service-canary-7f8b9 -c model -n prod
ERROR: model path not found: /models/canary/v2/model.pt
Traceback: FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory
```

sophia_eng: that path should come from env MODEL_PATH. checking the deployment we pushed ~10m ago.

sophia_eng: pasted the new manifest snippet: `env: - name: MODEL_PATH value: /models/canary/v2/model.pt` — but the canary image expects `/models/canary/v2/weights/model.pt` (nested dir). mismatch.

maria_sre: confirmed. old RS uses `/models/canary/v1/weights/model.pt`. new v2 missing `weights/` segment. parity break.

jake_oncall: HPA creating lots of pods, some fail init and crashloop. customers might see degraded inference latency/errors. @kyle_support any reports?

kyle_support: getting multiple customer tickets about 503s from inference endpoints since ~11:22 UTC. Top affected orgs: acme-inc, fastchat.impact: elevated error rates on real-time endpoints, retrying clients see timeouts.

david_pm: what's the blast radius? Can we flip the feature flag to stop routing to this canary?

sophia_eng: yes we have a feature flag `canary_route_v2` in LaunchDarkly. Recommend toggle off to cut traffic to canary immediately while we fix manifest.

jake_oncall: agreed. do it now, then scale down canary pods. I'll coordinate rollback if toggle doesn't fully stop traffic.

kyle_support: toggled `canary_route_v2` -> OFF :white_check_mark: (LD audit id 5a3f). Observability: traffic to canary back down to ~1% within 30s.

maria_sre: scaling canary down to 0 to free HPA churn:
```
kubectl scale rs inference-service-canary-7f8b9 --replicas=0 -n prod
kubectl get pods -l app=inference-service -n prod
```

(small window)

maria_sre: canary pods terminating, HPA stabilized, node pressure easing. CPU/ram back to baseline on nodes.

sophia_eng: we'll prepare a corrected manifest (restore `weights/` path) and run a dry-run in staging. Also adding a prestart check to catch missing model file earlier.

jake_oncall: good. For now, doing a controlled rollback of the deployment to previous replicaset to be safe. @deploy-bot please `rollout undo` for inference-service to last stable revision.

deploy-bot: Rollout undo initiated for deployment/inference-service in prod by jake_oncall. Command: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-service -n prod` — started, watching events.

maria_sre: monitoring logs and K8s events. No new crashloops after rollback.

kyle_support: customer impact reduced: tickets updated, setting status page to "degraded" -> now "recovering". Customers notified ETA: 30m.

david_pm: good call on feature flag kill-switch. We should add a post-deploy sanity check to CI that asserts MODEL_PATH exists in image or container startup fails fast with clear metric.

sophia_eng: already on it — PR incoming to add a readiness probe that checks model file presence. Also adding a validation hook in our deploy pipeline to diff model path env vs image layout.

jake_oncall: handing off to @maria_sre for follow-up/root cause and MTR doc. I'll be offline for next rotation but will review postmortem.

incident-bot: On-call handoff: previous oncall jake_oncall -> new assignee maria_sre. Incident state: mitigated (traffic cut, rollback complete). Priority: P1 -> postmortem required.

maria_sre: compiling timeline and actions, will open incident postmortem ticket and link logs + LD toggle audit. Missed guardrails: manifest validation and lack of file-exists readiness probe.

kyle_support: closing customer-facing incident note for now. Will update customers when postmortem done.

sophia_eng: thanks everyone. quick checklist: 1) add manifest linter rule, 2) add model-path readiness check, 3) run a canary test that validates a small inference call before routing traffic.

maria_sre: confirmed. last check: service endpoints green, error rate back to normal for 10m. marking incident as resolved in monitoring once stable for 30m.

jake_oncall: thanks team :thumbsup: — great quick kill-switch usage and rollback. Postmortem owner: sophia_eng + maria_sre.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated). Postmortem ticket: INC-2026-3345678901.
